items.title: SD-014 wanting/liking representational-separability RETEST (incentive-sensitization decouple)
items.note: Post-fix retest of V3-EXQ-887 (FAILED C2 |Spearman(w,l)|=0.93-0.97 because VALENCE_WANTING and VALENCE_LIKING were both monotone transforms of one shared benefit_exposure). SD-014 incentive-sensitization write-path decouple IMPLEMENTED ree-v3 2026-08-07: per-node, drive-coupled, saturating gain on VALENCE_WANTING (Smith/Berridge/Aldridge 2011: DA sensitization raises wanting not liking). This driver is the V3-EXQ-887 instrument unchanged (same P0 control, R1-R4 readiness, C1/C2/C3 acceptance) plus incentive_sensitization_enabled=True and drive_level threaded into update_benefit_salience. Smoke PASS (mechanism unit test: |Spearman| 1.0->0.85 on independent drive axis, OFF path bit-identical); dry-run runs end-to-end. Runs the full 40-episode x 3-seed rollout for the pre-registered verdict.
